interface.title: GBM drug response from GDSC: structure, selectivity, combinations (Streamlit dashboard)
interface.field: Cancer pharmacology / cheminformatics (glioblastoma drug screening, GDSC release 8.5)
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing and interpreting finished results from a pipeline that has already been run (read-only browsing)
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse precomputed results on which GDSC compounds are selective for glioblastoma: a selectivity volcano plot, a per-drug table, benchmarks of structure-based models against y-scrambled nulls, structural similarity heatmaps, ranked combination hypotheses with a structural flag screen, and pathway enrichment.

data.note: All tables ship with the repo (run 2026-09-27, commit a14c7ad6, GDSC release 8.5): 20,329 dose-response curves, 34 GBM cell lines, 542 drugs, 24 GBM-selective drugs (FDR<0.05). Nothing was uploaded or recomputed.

tree.general: Find compounds that act selectively on one disease's cell lines, judge how well chemical structure predicts both their potency and their selectivity, and turn the hits into combination and mechanism hypotheses
tree.specific: Use the GDSC results to shortlist GBM-selective drugs, benchmark structure-based predictors of GBM potency, selectivity and selective class, compare candidate structures, review combination pairs and check pathway enrichment

features.name: Volcano plot with threshold, hover details and legend isolation
features.general: Plot effect size against significance for every item, colour the items that pass both thresholds, hover a point for its annotations, zoom into the hit cluster, hide the non-hits and export the figure
features.specific: Selectivity volcano: z_mean vs -log10 q, FDR 0.05 dashed line, red = gbm_selective; hover shows putative_target, pathway_name and n_cell_lines; headline counts above it (e.g. 24 drugs pass FDR<0.05)
steps: hover a point to read its drug, target, pathway and statistics
drag a box to zoom into the selective cluster
click a legend entry to hide non-selective drugs
double-click to zoom back out
download the plot as PNG
serves_tasks: See which items pass the significance and effect-size thresholds on a volcano plot
Inspect individual hits on the plot
Focus the plot on the selective cluster

features.name: Filterable results table with a 'hits only' toggle
features.general: Narrow a per-item results table with a free-text filter across name and annotation columns plus a checkbox for significant items, then sort, hide columns and search inside what is left
features.specific: Drugs table: 'Filter by drug name / target / pathway' text box plus 'GBM-selective only' checkbox, then Show/hide columns, header sort and in-grid Search over oof_pred_* and novelty_score
steps: type a target, pathway or drug name into the filter
tick 'GBM-selective only'
click a column header to sort
hide columns you do not need with the eye icon
search inside the grid to highlight matches
serves_tasks: Narrow the table to hits in a mechanism class
Compare predicted scores for the shortlisted items
Look up a reference compound to check whether it is a hit

features.name: Model benchmark chart with task/metric selectors and a permutation null
features.general: Pick a prediction target and a metric, compare models as bars with bootstrap confidence intervals under a grouped and a structure-disjoint split, read the best model's score against scrambled-label runs, and inspect its predicted vs observed scatter
features.specific: Benchmark: Task (gbm_potency / gbm_selectivity / gbm_selective_class) and Metric dropdowns (regression: mae, pearson_r, r2, rmse, spearman_rho; classification: balanced_accuracy, brier, mcc, pr_auc, roc_auc) drive a grouped-vs-scaffold bar chart and an out-of-fold scatter; the y-scrambling line shows one stored model/metric per task from y_scrambling_summary.json and does not follow the Metric dropdown
steps: choose a Task
choose a Metric (the list changes with the task type)
compare scaffold against grouped bars to judge skill on unseen scaffolds, isolating one split through the legend
read the y-scrambling real vs permuted score and empirical p
hover the out-of-fold scatter to find badly predicted drugs
serves_tasks: Compare models on one target and metric under two cross-validation schemes, and judge whether predictive skill holds on structural families not seen in training
Check the best model against a scrambled-label null
Inspect predicted against observed values per item

features.name: Paired similarity heatmaps with an agreement test
features.general: Show the same item-by-item similarity matrix under several measures, hover a cell to read its value, zoom into a block, and use Mantel tests to see whether the measures agree
features.specific: Similarity: Tanimoto, MCS and GNN-cosine heatmaps over the 30 candidate drugs (same order), with box-zoom and reset, plus a Mantel tests table (r, p, n_pairs, 999 permutations)
steps: hover a cell to read the pair and its similarity
hover the same pair in the other two heatmaps
drag a box to zoom into a block of drugs
reset the axes
read the Mantel r and p for each pair of measures
serves_tasks: Read the similarity of one pair under each measure
Check whether the similarity measures agree

features.name: Top-N ranked pair table with a separate structural flag screen
features.general: Set how many top-ranked pair hypotheses to show, read the score parts and rationale, re-sort by one part, then check pairs against a fixed table of rule-based compatibility flags
features.specific: Combinations: 'Show top N pairs' slider (10–100) over the ranked pair table (total_score, target_diversity, pathway_complementarity, potency, structural_novelty, tanimoto, rationale) plus a Structural screen table (alert_level, n_flags, rules, details) that shows interaction_screen.csv in full and does not follow the slider or the pair table
steps: drag the slider or use the keyboard to set N
scroll right to the score parts and rationale
sort by a score part such as structural_novelty
sort the structural screen by n_flags
search the screen for 'no_flag' pairs
serves_tasks: Choose how many top-ranked pairs to show and read their score parts
Re-rank by a single score part
Check the pairs for rule-based compatibility flags

features.name: Enrichment results table with gene search
features.general: Browse over-representation results (overlap, set size, p, q, fold enrichment, member genes), find terms containing a gene of interest, and rank by effect size in fullscreen
features.specific: Pathways: hypergeometric Reactome_2022 enrichment of GBM-selective drug targets against the 285-gene screened background; only terms with q < cfg.PATHWAY_FDR are shown (top 30 if none pass), with in-grid Search, header sort and Fullscreen
steps: scroll to p, q, fold_enrichment and genes
search a gene symbol such as MTOR to highlight matching terms
sort by fold_enrichment
open fullscreen to see all columns
